title: Implement single-owner computer start and readiness
description:
Implement the lifecycle required by the single-start and readiness stories.

Acceptance criteria:
- A conditional start claim is keyed by tenant_id and computer_id.
- Repeated and concurrent requests converge on one logical host start.
- Readiness is recorded independently for model, workspace, and browser capabilities.
- A stopped or wedged host claim expires and can be reclaimed.
- A stale local host cannot regain prefer-local routing until it reconciles with the current snapshot generation.
